basic_details.job_title: HBCHRC Muzaffarpur Project Research Scientist Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre Muzaffarpur (HBCHRC Muzaffarpur) has announced recruitment for 1 Project Research Scientist (Non-Medical) post on a contract basis under the project entitled “Identification of Genetic Predictors Responsible for Local Failure in Margin- Negative Oral Squamous Cell Carcinoma Patients in India” funded by Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), initially for a period of six months or till the continuation of project, whichever is earlier. qualification.details: Post Essential Qualification and Experience Project Research Scientist (Non-Medical) Master Degree in Bioinformatics or in any stream of biological Sciences or Life Sciences with minimum 55% marks. | Desirable experience: | Candidates having extensive experience in analysis of cancer genomics including analysis on next-generation sequencing (NGS) data from biological and clinical samples for Whole genome/exome sequencing/transcriptomic, targeted sequencing of limited gene panel, and establishment of in-house bioinformatics pipeline for the same. Candidate must have a sound knowledge in Linux, scripting, R programming. Candidates working in academic institutions with minimum 2 years of proven experience will be preferred.

how_to_apply: Candidates are required to carry Bio-data, Recent Passport Size Photograph, Original Documents of PAN Card, Aadhar Card, Experience Certificates, Education Certificates and One Set of Self-Attested Copies of All Certificates for attending Walk-In-Interview between 9.00 am to 10.00 am at HOMI BHABHA CANCER HOSPITAL AND RESEARCH CENTRE, SHRI KRISHNA MEDICAL COLLEGE AND HOSPITAL CAMPUS, UMANAGAR, MUZAFFARPUR (BIHAR) - 842004.
Outstation candidates may attend the Interview Online.
Candidates are requested to mention for which post they have applied for in the subject line of the mail.
Send resume along with the supporting documents (Educational Certificates, Experience Certificates and copy of AADHAR & PAN Card) in a single PDF file on [email protected].

Last date for receiving application through email requesting for online interview will be 31.10.2026 up to 3:00 PM. Only Shortlisted Candidates who will be fulfilling the norms will be contacted for Online Interview.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Interested and eligible candidates may attend Walk-In-Interview for the post under the ICMR-funded project. Outstation candidates may attend the Interview Online. Desirable experience: Candidates having extensive experience in analysis of cancer genomics including analysis on next-generation sequencing (NGS) data from biological and clinical samples for Whole genome/exome sequencing/transcriptomic, targeted sequencing of limited gene panel, and establishment of in-house bioinformatics pipeline for the same. Candidate must have a sound knowledge in Linux, scripting, R programming. Candidates working in academic institutions with minimum 2 years of proven experience will be preferred.

rows.essential_qualification_and_experience: Master Degree in Bioinformatics or in any stream of biological Sciences or Life Sciences with minimum 55% marks.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated monthly remuneration for the Project Research Scientist (Non-Medical) post is Rs. 61,040/- PM. The appointment is initially for a period of six months or till the continuation of project, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for HBCHRC Muzaffarpur Project Research Scientist (Non-Medical)
content_sections.text: Candidates are required to carry Bio-data, Recent Passport Size Photograph, Original Documents of PAN Card, Aadhar Card, Experience Certificates, Education Certificates and One Set of Self-Attested Copies of All Certificates for attending Walk-In-Interview between 9.00 am to 10.00 am at HOMI BHABHA CANCER HOSPITAL AND RESEARCH CENTRE, SHRI KRISHNA MEDICAL COLLEGE AND HOSPITAL CAMPUS, UMANAGAR, MUZAFFARPUR (BIHAR) - 842004. Outstation candidates may attend the Interview Online. Candidates are requested to mention for which post they have applied for in the subject line of the mail. Send resume along with the supporting documents (Educational Certificates, Experience Certificates and copy of AADHAR & PAN Card) in a single PDF file on [email protected] . Last date for receiving application through email requesting for online interview will be 31.10.2026 up to 3:00 PM. Only Shortlisted Candidates who will be fulfilling the norms will be contacted for Online Interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be carried out through a Walk-In-Interview or an Online Interview for outstation candidates. Only Shortlisted Candidates who will be fulfilling the norms will be contacted for Online Interview.
